name: Sishir Canyon
summary: Sishir Canyon runs east through the Stonetalon Mountains, crowded with Deepmoss spiders. Webs choke the gorge on the dangerous approach to the Ruins of Eldre'thar, where travelers face venomous spiders and their matriarch.

sections.title: The Webbed Pass
sections.body: Sishir Canyon cuts through the Stonetalon Mountains toward the ancient Ruins of Eldre'thar. Deepmoss spiders have overrun the gorge, covering its stone floor and walls with sheets of web and clusters of egg sacs. Travelers and sentinels heading for the night elven ruins must fight their way through swarms of aggressive webspinners.

sections.title: Besseleth's Domain
sections.body: Besseleth lurks in the deepest recess of Sishir Canyon as matriarch of the Deepmoss brood. Her great size and venom make her a danger to anyone trying to secure the pass. Local forces in Stonetalon keep watch and warn travelers that the webbed depths hold more than scattered spiders: Besseleth fiercely guards her brood.

faq.answer: Sishir Canyon is a gorge in the Stonetalon Mountains that winds from the main mountain paths toward the ancient Ruins of Eldre'thar.

faq.q: What creatures live in the canyon?
faq.answer: Predatory Deepmoss spiders have claimed the canyon. They cover the ravine with webs and egg sacs and prey on creatures that enter their territory.
Besseleth is the massive, deadly matriarch of the Deepmoss brood, dwelling deep within Sishir Canyon. She is a grave threat to travelers passing through.

aliases: what is at the end of sishir canyon
faq.answer: Follow Sishir Canyon east to reach the Ruins of Eldre'thar, an ancient night elven site high in the mountains.

angles.text: As a Night Elf, you must fight through dense spider nests to reach the ancestral Ruins of Eldre'thar, since the overrun canyon blocks safe passage. Kaldorei sentinels and scholars face the same danger.
As a Hunter, you can test your skill tracking and trapping wild beasts in Sishir Canyon's tight ravine. Its webs and venomous Deepmoss spiders make the work dangerous.
